story.text: The two little pigs ran to their brother, who had built his house with {BRICKS}. The wolf huffed and puffed, but he could not blow it {DOWN}. So he tried a {TRICK}: “Meet me at six, and we’ll dig {TURNIPS}!” But the little pig got up at {FIVE}, and was home {SAFE} before the wolf came.
story.caption: He built his house with bricks
